move: product card lifts, flips 180 to specs, rows slide in, flips back
how: A 400x520 card with a front (gradient hero, name, price, button) and a dark back (spec rows, CTA) in a 1600px perspective scene over a rotating blurred conic blob. The card floats y -8 with a slight rotationX in one sine yoyo cycle; at 0.175 D it rotates Y to 180 with expo.inOut over 0.9s while scaling to 1.08 and back, the spec rows slide in from x 24 with staggered expo.out and the CTA rises; at 0.675 D it rotates on to 360 with the same lift and the front body items re-enter with a stagger. A hint label pulses opacity. rotationY 360 equals 0 so the loop closes.
adapt: Replace the hero gradient, product name, price, spec rows and CTA text, the card size and corner radius, the blob colours. Keep the 0.9s expo.inOut flip with the scale lift and the stagger after each flip.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the scene, card faces and hint; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with flips at 0.175 D and 0.675 D and durations as fractions of D. The from() tweens need immediateRender:false as in the original; selectors scoped to el.
caveats: filter: blur(60px) on the 900px conic blob is slow to render
